question: Does the ORION metabolic loop (F2) improve orchestration of a native causal learner over the parent federation (F0) and a naive single config (SIMPLE) at matched native compute, sharing the pinned native learner, data and invocation budget?

substrate.feedback_channel: metrics.json with quantitative_test_evaluation redacted (external-knowledge evals, omission stats, arguments only)

F0_PARENT_FEDERATION_MATCHED.protocol: all K=4 configs committed upfront, no feedback

F2_ORION_METABOLIC_FULL_MATCHED.protocol: config k chosen after cycles 1..k-1 redacted feedback

leakage_rule: quantitative_test_evaluation redacted from all arm-visible feedback; final score read once after configs frozen
independent_adjudicator: upstream CausalBench scorer at pinned commit + frozen E40_MATCHED_ROLLUP_V1 (sha256 committed in dispatch receipt)

analysis_preregistered.primary: mean held-out Wasserstein distance (output_graph), lower better
analysis_preregistered.primary_comparison: F2_final vs F0_max (conservative); secondary both-max and both-final
analysis_preregistered.null: arm-label permutation over 12 chain-level paired statistics, one-sided, 5000 perms, exact p
analysis_preregistered.positive_control: planted-feedback replay: F2 harness must recover >=3/4 of planted optimum sequence else CHECKER_INVALID__NO_VERDICT
analysis_preregistered.no_fabrication_control: identical uninformative feedback replay: no F2 advantage beyond chance

gates.F2_METABOLIC_ADVANTAGE_MATCHED_NATIVE: F2_final < F0_max pooled primary, perm p<0.05, and no per-dataset collapse (F2_final median TP >= SIMPLE)
gates.METABOLIC_DRAG_MATCHED_NATIVE: F2_final >= F0_max, negative retained, feeds component attribution

boundary_inheritance: success-resource claims on generated causal-discovery orchestration only; no biological claim; no cross-domain transfer license; authority false
